scenario: Release and spill timing at dt = 1/60 s: surplus loads (faster swing, rate cap), an idle below-threshold tray, and elements fired into a swinging tray.

inputs.kindOf: kinds list indexed by id; ids 0..n-1 initially, launches get the next id
inputs.launch_rule: recorder: a launch offered at step i is added iff hiveAccepts(hive, red, centre of taking cell, mid opening z, vel = {x:0, y:hiveApproachSign(taking), z:-10}); then step i is run. Each scenario is run twice from the same inputs, once with hiveTimerStep and once with hiveStep. A run stops 2 steps after the first tipped=true step (never for below_threshold), or at max_steps.
inputs.timer_steps_note: timer_steps rows omit hive.contents (hiveTimerStep returns it untouched; the recorder asserts it); step_steps rows carry it
inputs.initial_hive: contents = ids of initial_kinds, tips 0, tipping 0, released false, no swingRate key
inputs.key_note: a hive with no swingRate key means undefined (key omitted)
